column2: SELECT min(n_nationkey),max(n_nationkey),avg(n_nationkey),count(*) FROM nation;
SELECT n_regionkey,sum(n_nationkey),count(*) FROM nation GROUP BY n_regionkey HAVING sum(n_nationkey)>30 ORDER BY n_regionkey;
SELECT c,count(*),sum(s) FROM (SELECT n_regionkey,count(*) c,sum(n_nationkey) s FROM nation GROUP BY n_regionkey) x GROUP BY c ORDER BY c;
SELECT r.r_regionkey,a.v FROM region r JOIN (SELECT n_regionkey k,avg(n_nationkey)*10000000000000000.00 v FROM nation GROUP BY n_regionkey) a ON r.r_regionkey=a.k ORDER BY r.r_regionkey;
SELECT r.r_regionkey,count(n.n_nationkey) FROM region r LEFT JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey=n.n_regionkey AND n.n_nationkey<4 GROUP BY r.r_regionkey ORDER BY r.r_regionkey;
SELECT r_regionkey FROM region r WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nation n WHERE n.n_regionkey=r.r_regionkey AND n.n_nationkey<4) ORDER BY r_regionkey;
SELECT r_regionkey FROM region r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nation n WHERE n.n_regionkey=r.r_regionkey AND n.n_nationkey<4) ORDER BY r_regionkey;
SELECT n_regionkey,count(DISTINCT n_nationkey),count(n_nationkey) FROM nation GROUP BY n_regionkey ORDER BY n_regionkey;
SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation WHERE n_regionkey NOT IN (SELECT r_regionkey FROM region WHERE r_regionkey<2) ORDER BY n_nationkey;
SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation WHERE n_regionkey NOT IN (SELECT CASE WHEN r_regionkey=0 THEN NULL ELSE r_regionkey END FROM region WHERE r_regionkey<2) ORDER BY n_nationkey;
SELECT n_regionkey,sum(n_nationkey) FROM nation GROUP BY n_regionkey HAVING sum(n_nationkey)>(SELECT avg(r_regionkey) FROM region) ORDER BY n_regionkey;
SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation WHERE n_regionkey=(SELECT 2) ORDER BY n_nationkey;
SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation WHERE n_regionkey=(SELECT 1 WHERE false) ORDER BY n_nationkey;
WITH c AS (SELECT n_regionkey k,sum(n_nationkey) s FROM nation GROUP BY n_regionkey) SELECT k,s FROM c WHERE s=(SELECT max(s) FROM c) ORDER BY k;
SELECT substring(n_name::text,1,2),count(*) FROM nation GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation ORDER BY n_nationkey DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n_regionkey=(SELECT min(r_regionkey) FROM region r WHERE r_regionkey=n.n_regionkey) ORDER BY n_nationkey;

SELECT a.n_nationkey FROM nation a WHERE a.n_nationkey=(SELECT min(b.n_nationkey) FROM nation b WHERE b.n_nationkey=a.n_nationkey AND b.n_regionkey=a.n_regionkey AND b.n_nationkey<10) ORDER BY a.n_nationkey;

SELECT a.n_nationkey FROM nation a WHERE a.n_regionkey=(SELECT min(r_regionkey) FROM region r WHERE r_regionkey=a.n_regionkey) AND a.n_regionkey<(SELECT sum(r_regionkey) FROM region r WHERE r_regionkey=a.n_regionkey) ORDER BY a.n_nationkey;
SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM region r WHERE r_regionkey=n.n_nationkey)=0 ORDER BY n_nationkey;
SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n_nationkey=20 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM region r WHERE r_regionkey=n.n_nationkey)>0 ORDER BY n_nationkey;
SELECT min(n_name),max(n_name) FROM nation;
